text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After school, Misato and {0} begin practicing beach baseball with the other club members.
text_block_list.orig_text:
放課後、ミサトと{0}は、
部員たちとビーチベースボールの練習を始める。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Good work in class, everyone~ Now it's time for club practice! Let's get fired up~ ...Oh my, where's Asahi-kun?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
授業お疲れさま～
さあ
部活の時間よ。
張り切っていきましょうね～
……あら、
アサヒ君は？

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Apparently, he's on duty today. He said he'll come over when he's finished, so we should start without him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は日直だそうだ。
終わったら行くから、
先に始めててくれだと。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my, is that so? Then, let's get started. Everyone, be careful not to get hurt!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
そうなのね～
じゃあ
始めちゃいましょうか。
みんな、
怪我には気をつけるのよ～！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Yeah, leave it to me. You bastards... you know what to do, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
任せとけ。
テメェら……
分かってるな？

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おう！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: We'll start with a warm-up. The teacher told us to be careful not to get hurt. So let's get our shoulders... WARMED UP!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずウォーミングアップからだ。
先生も怪我に気をつけろって言ってるからな。
肩慣らしといこうじゃねえか……
おらあっ！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: Oww, ouch! Don't just go for a joint lock out of nowhere!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いでで！
いきなり関節技かますんじゃねえ！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: An old man like you needs this much to loosen up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジジイはこれくらいしねえと、
ほぐれねえだろ。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: Ukeke! You shouldn't do pro wrestling on the beach! At this rate, you'll be covered in dirt in no time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ウケケ！　
ビーチでプロレスなんかするもんじゃねえな！
これじゃあ、
あっという間に全身汚れちまうぜ！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Ah, right! We even had these uniforms just washed. So anyway... let's go for some more! LIKE THIS!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
せっかく洗ってもらったばかりなのにな。
つーわけで……
もっといくぞ！　
おらあ！！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Treating me like an old man so brazenly...! I'll show you that I won't lose to any young whippersnapper just yet! HMPH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ……
ワシを年寄り扱いしやがって……！
若いモンにはまだ負けんってとこ、
見せてやるからな！　
ふんぬー！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: Ukeke! Let me join in! DORYAAAAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ウケケ！
オレも混ぜろよ！　
どりゃー！！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Fufu, so energetic~! Keep up the good work~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
とっても元気ね～！　
その調子よ～！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my, I don't think so... Maybe it just looks that way because they're so enthusiastic?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
そうは思えないけど……
張り切ってるから、
そう見えるだけじゃないかしら～？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Daichi-kun. Aren't you going to join us? I was hoping you could teach everyone how to practice until Asahi-kun arrives...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
ダイチ君。
あなたは一緒にやらないの？
アサヒ君が来るまで、
みんなに練習を教えてあげてほしいんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Daichi
text_block_list.text: I'm not getting involved. Besides, what they're doing right now is... Hmph. Never mind.
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺は関わらねえよ。
それにあいつらが今やってんのは……
ふん。
なんでもねえ。

text_block_list.name: Daichi
text_block_list.text: Don't expect too much from us, okay? You'll probably regret it. Well, it doesn't really concern me either way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺らに期待すんのも程々にしとけよな？
きっと後悔するぞ。
まあどっちにしろ俺には関係ねえけどよ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: As a teacher, it's only natural for me to have high expectations of my students~ I'd love to see you play~
text_block_list.orig_text:
先生だから、
生徒に期待するのは当然じゃない～
あなたがプレイするところを見てみたいわ～

text_block_list.name: Daichi
text_block_list.text: Hmph...
text_block_list.orig_text: ふん……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my, he's gone... Hmm... I wonder how we can get Daichi-kun to join the club...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら
行っちゃったわ
……
どうしたらダイチ君も部活をやってくれるのかしら……

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Alright, this should be good enough for a warm-up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
ウォーミングアップはこれくらいで十分だろ。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: So this is how dirty beach baseball uniforms get, huh? Ukekeke!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ビーチベースボールってのは、
こんなにもユニフォームが汚れるもんなんだなあ？　
ウケケ！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my, are you done stretching? What are you going to do next?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
ストレッチはもう終わり？
次は
なにをするのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Yup. Next we'll play some catch.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
次はキャッチボールをやる。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my! It's really starting to look like a beach baseball club, that's great! Is there anything I can do to help? I'd love to join the practice as an advisor.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
ビーチベースボール部らしくなってきていいわね～！
私にも
なにかお手伝いできることはないかしら？
顧問として
私も練習に参加したいの。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Perfect timing... In that case, could you go and pick up any balls that fly off? We're complete amateurs who've barely ever thrown a ball before. We don't know where they might end up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょうどいい……
だったら、
暴投しちまったボールを拾ってきてくれ。
オレたちはロクにボールも投げたことねえ素人だ。
どこに飛んでいくか分からん。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: If we have to go and retrieve each ball ourselves, it'll be a waste of practice time. So if you could collect them for us, that waste wouldn't exist.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オレたちが一球一球取りに行ってると、
練習の時間がもったいない。
だから先生が集めてきてくれるなら、
その無駄もなくなるからな。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Fufu, got it! Leave it to Sensei, feel free to throw the ball with all your might!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
分かったわ～！
先生に任せて、
みんなは思い
っきりボールを投げてちょうだいね。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Did you hear that? She said to throw with all our might... HERE GOES!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今の聞いたか？
思いっきり投げろだとよ……
そぉらっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: Damn, you just hit a home run during a game of catch!! Hyahaha! If you keep throwing wild pitches like that, no amount of balls will be enough!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャッチボールでホームランが出たぜー！　
ヒャハハ！
毎回あんな暴投じゃ、
ボールがいくつあっても足りねえぜ！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. Our teacher is here to retrieve them for us... Isn't that right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
心配するな。
先生が取りに行ってくれるからよ。
な、
そうだろ？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Sure~ Let's do this together, {0}-kun. Everyone, please keep playing catch~
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいわよ～
一緒に行きましょう、{0}君。
みんなは
キャッチボールを続けていてちょうだいね～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I think it flew around here. I wonder where it is...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
この辺りに飛んでいったと思うんだけど、
どこかしら……？

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Teach! There's another flying your way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すまねえ先生～！　
またそっちに飛んだぞ！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh myyy~?
text_block_list.orig_text: あら～？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: EEEK!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃっ！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Thank you, {0}-kun. Nice catch!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、
{0}君。
ナイスキャッチね～！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: My oh my, so many balls are flying towards us one after the other~ We have to pick them all up. Let's hurry~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
またたくさんボールが飛んできたわ～
全部拾ってあげなくちゃ。
ちょっと
急ぎましょうか～

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's go to the next one. You guys better catch it properly this time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし次行くぞ。
テメェら今度こそちゃんと捕れよ。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: Gahaha! You're the one who's throwing it in the wrong direction!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ガハハ！
オマエが明後日の方向に投げてんだろうが！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: Still, you've got a great arm and shoulders to be able to throw that far. Maybe you'd do well in beach baseball?
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかしよー、
あんな遠くまで投げられるなんて、
オマエいい肩してるぞ。
もしかしてビーチベースボールに向いてるんじゃねえか？

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Stop messing around. Like I'd ever understand what's so fun about throwing a ball around like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
冗談よせよ。
こんなボールを投げて、
なにが楽しいのか全く分からねえ。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: That said... I wonder if she's really going to pick up every last one of them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしてもな……
全部拾ってくるだろうか、
あの先生は。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: She keeps talking like she's some kind of saint, but she's a teacher like any other. She'll get fed up with us soon enough. Every single one of them is only capable of looking at us like garbage.
text_block_list.orig_text:
聖人みたいな言葉ばかり並べてるが、
他の教師たちと同じだ。
すぐオレたちに愛想つかすに決まっている。
どいつもこいつも
オレたちをゴミみたいな目で見るしか能のない連中だ。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Now then, the last ball available is the one in my hand... So, this will be the finishing blow... Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
手元に残ってるボールはこれが最後だな……
それじゃトドメだ……
ん？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Ehe~! Sorry for the wait~! *Pant* We picked them all up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おまたせ～！　
拾ってきたわよ～！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: What...? Hey, did you really pick ALL of them?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに……？
おい、
本当に全部拾ってきたのか？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Hmm... One, two... Yeah, it should be all of them. Sorry for the wait~
text_block_list.orig_text:
いち、
に……
うん、
全部あるはずよ。
遅くなっちゃって
ごめんね～

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: No, that's not the issue. We, umm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
そういうことじゃない。
オレらが、
その……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...? But more importantly, it's amazing how far you can throw~ I'm sure you'll do great in a real game~
text_block_list.orig_text:
……？
それより、
あんなに遠くまで投げられるなんてすごいわ～
きっと
試合でも大活躍するに違いないわね～

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: What?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なにっ！？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: You even put your hearts into your stretches. That makes Sensei so happy~! Your uniforms got dirty already, but don't worry~ I'll clean them every day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ストレッチも気合い十分だったし、
先生うれしいわ～
さっそく汚れちゃったけど、
毎日洗濯するから
気にしないでちょうだいね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Keep practicing a lot, and don't worry about getting them dirty~! That dirt is proof that you are all working hard~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからもい
っぱい練習して、
どんどん汚しちゃって構わないわよ～
その汚れは、
みんなが頑張ってる証なんですから～

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Why aren't you mad at us...?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうしてオレたちを怒らない……？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Hm? I should be mad at you? I wonder why~? If anything, I should be apologizing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたたちを怒る？　
どうしてかしら～？
それより
謝るのは先生の方よ……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I must've surprised you at first. After all, I, a special lecturer, suddenly asked you all to resume your club activities...
text_block_list.orig_text:
きっと
初めは驚いたと思うの。
特別講師の私が、
いきなり部活をやろうなんて
お願いをしたから……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: But... to see you practicing so hard... Sensei's overjoyed to have met such kind students!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
こんなに一生懸命練習してくれて……
みんなのような優しい生徒と出会えて、
先生はとってもうれしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Are you serious...?
text_block_list.orig_text: 本気で言っているのか……？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Yes, as serious as I can be!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
本気ですよ～！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: Gahahaha! It's just like I said! She's definitely different from the others!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ガハハハハ！　
ワシの言った通りだったな！
やっぱ
他のヤツらとは違えぜ！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: Seriously, I can't believe a teacher like this exists...
text_block_list.orig_text: マジでこんな先生がいるなんてな……

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Hey, you. Is this teacher... always like this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なあ、
おい。
この先生、
いつもこんな調子なのか？

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: A-A LAP PILLOW, YOU SAYYY?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひ、
膝枕だとぉ～～！？

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: By lap pillow, you mean... that one? You've put your head on her lap... and then had her gently pat you on your head? That one?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
膝枕ってのは、
あれか？
先生の膝の上に、
オマエの頭を乗せて……
それで
優しく撫でてもらったりとかしちゃうのか？　
そうなのか！？

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: He's just a kid, yet he's living the life already...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ガキのくせして、
なんていい思いをしてんだ……

text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
いたいたー！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Hatsune-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら～！　
ハツネちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Here I am! Sparkleee☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も来ちゃったのだ！　
きらーん☆

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Oh, but, but! Don't worry! I've asked Aoi-chan to take on our work as "Forestier"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
でもでも安心して！
【フォレスティエ】の仕事は、
アオイちゃんにお願いしたから！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's reassuring to hear. But... that outfit...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
それなら安心ね。
でも
その格好……？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I heard that you became the advisor for the beach baseball club, so I thought I'd like to help out too, Misato-sensei!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミサト先生がビーチベースボール部の顧問になった
って聞いたから、
私もお手伝いしたいなって思って！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I want to support you, {0}-kun, and all the club members at the same time, so I'm going to join the club as a cheerleader!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミサト先生も、
{0}くんも、
部員のみー
んなもまとめて応援しようと思って、
チアリーダーとして、
私も部活に入っちゃうよー！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: My oh my! We've got such a reliable new ally~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら～、
とっても
心強い味方が増えたわね～！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: Another young girl has arrived...? And she also seems to be well acquainted with {0}...
text_block_list.orig_text:
また若い娘さんが増えた……？
{0}の
知り合いのようだけどよぉ……

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: Hatsune-chan... huh? She looks like a nice, cheerful girl...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハツネ……
ちゃん
って言うのか。
明るくていい子そうじゃねえか……

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: I don't want to admit it, but if you look closely at that teacher...
text_block_list.orig_text:
認めたくはねえが、
あの先生もよく見たら……

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: Yeah... She's a beauty...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
激マブだぜ……

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: I noticed it from the very beginning! The charm of the teacher... no, Misato-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ワシは最初から気付いていたぞ！
先生の……
いや、
ミサトちゃんの魅力に！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Referring to her with "-chan" out of nowhere... You're being way too forward.
text_block_list.orig_text:
急にちゃん付けしやがって……
調子良すぎるぞ。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: Hm? Well, I mean... I'm older, and I've always been the type to take the initiative.
text_block_list.orig_text:
む？　
だって
ワシの方が年上だし、
グイグイ引っ張っていくタイプだからな。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my~? You've been whispering in secret for a while now. What are you talking about? Let Sensei in, too~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら～？　
さっきからこそこそ
内緒話かしら～？
どんなことをお喋りしてるの？　
先生もまぜてちょうだい～

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: A-Actually, I... all this time, for you Misato-chan... OUCH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じ、
実はその……
ワシはずっと前から
ミサトちゃんのことが……
いてっ！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Don't do it. You'll just end up getting rejected anyway. An old man like you has no chance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やめとけ。
どうせフラれるのがオチだ。
オヤジのオマエじゃ、
無理に決まってる。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Ah! So you must be the club members! I'm Hatsune. Nice to meet you all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
あなたたちが部員だね！
私はハツネ。
今日からよろしくね！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Besides cheering, I will also help out with club activities, so if you have any problems, leave it to Hatsune-chan! Sparkleee☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
応援以外にも
部活のお手伝いとかもするから、
困ったことがあったら
ハツネちゃんにお任せなのだー！　
きらーん☆

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: Thump!
text_block_list.orig_text: ドッキーン！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Huh? You suddenly froze up, what happened? Did you perhaps hurt yourself during practice...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
急に固まっちゃって、
どうしたの？
もしかして
練習でどこか痛めたとか……

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: N-No! It's nothing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いや！　
なんでもねえ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Really? Then that's great!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなのー？　
なら
良かったー！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: ...This beach baseball club used to be nothing but a bunch of sweaty guys, but finally it seems a spring of youth is upon us...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……男ばっかでむさ苦しかったビーチベースボール部に、
ついに青春の予感が……！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: H-Hatsune-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハ、
ハツネちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Hm, what?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
なにー？

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! I was just wondering if it's okay if I call you "Hatsune-chan"...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
いや！
ハツネちゃん……
って、
呼んでもいいかなーって。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Of course it is!
text_block_list.orig_text: もちろんだよー！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: ...! Hatsune-chan! We're going to practice as hard as we can, so watch over us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！　
ハツネちゃん！
オレたち、
めちゃくちゃ練習頑張るから見ててくれ！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Which is why we want you to do your best supporting us, Hatsune-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
だからハツネちゃんも、
オレたちの応援を頼む。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Yeah, leave it to me! I'll cheer everyone up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
任せてー！
みんなに元気
あげちゃうよー！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: KHHHH! So reliable! Let's start practicing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くぅー！　
頼もしいぜ！
んじゃ
練習始めようぜ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: It's my turn now! Let's go with enthusiasm! Keep it up, keep it up! Go, fight! Goooo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっそく私の出番だね！　
張り切っていこうー！
フレー、
フレー！　
ゴー、
ファイト！　
ゴー！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: Hyahaha! Just having Hatsune-chan cheer me on makes me feel like I've become a master of this sport!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒャハハ！　
ハツネちゃんに応援されただけで、
なんかもううまくなった気がしてきたぜ！！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Having Hatsune-chan's support sure feels nice.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
いいもんだな、
ハツネちゃんの応援って。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: Witness, Misato-chan! My impressive super play! Gahahaha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見ててくださいね、
ミサトちゃん！
ワシのスーパープレーを！　
ガハハ！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Fufu, of course I will~ I'll always be watching over you all. Do your best~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
もちろんですよ～
みんなのことは、
いつでも見守っていますからね。
頑張って～！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: Yessss!!
text_block_list.orig_text: はーーーい！！

text_block_list.name: Asahi
text_block_list.text: H-Hey! What are you all doing in a uniform?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい！　
ユニフォームなんか着て
何してるんだよ！？

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: YOU'RE LATE, ASAHI! Bastard, are you up for this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
遅いぞ、アサヒ。
テメェやる気あるのかよ。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: Can't you tell just by looking? We're doing our club activities! Your favorite beach baseball!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見て分からねえのか？
部活だよ！　
オマエの大好きなビーチベースボールだ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: So you must be the captain, Asahi-kun! I'm the cheerleader, Hatsune-chan! Starting today, I'll be working with you! Sparkleee☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたがキャプテンのアサヒくんだね！
私、
チアリーダーのハツネちゃんなのだ！
今日からよろしくね！　
きらーん☆

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Everyone is super motivated, and it's fun to cheer them on! It looks like it's going to be a hot summer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなすっごくやる気で、
応援してて楽しいよ！
熱い夏になりそうだね！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Let's make this a summer to remember, Hatsune-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
最高の思い出を作ろうぜ、
ハツネちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Asahi
text_block_list.text: W-Wait a minute. Are you really... being serious about this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと待ってくれよ。
それ
本気で言ってるのか？

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: I've seen the light... all thanks to Ms. Misato and Hatsune-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
目覚めちまったんだよ。
ミサト先生とハツネちゃんのおかげでな。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Asahi-kun, could you teach everyone how to practice? I still don't really know much about beach baseball...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アサヒ君、
みんなに
練習を教えてあげてくれる？
私はまだ
ビーチベースボールのこと、
よく分からなくて……

text_block_list.name: Asahi
text_block_list.text: Looks like they're not lying... Understood, teacher. Let's start practicing then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうやら本当みたいだな……
分かりました、
先生。
それじゃあ
練習を始めよう！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Fufu! We're in your hands~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
よろしくね～！

text_block_list.name: Asahi
text_block_list.text: Right, when playing catch, try throwing the ball towards your partner's chest. When catching, don't just use one hand, but gently cup it with both hands... that way you can make a secure catch.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう、
キャッチボールは相手の胸元辺りを目掛けて投げてみて。
キャッチする時は
片手で捕るんじゃなくて、
両手で優しく包み込むように……
そうすれば
確実な捕球ができるよ。

text_block_list.name: 部員１
text_block_list.text: 相手の胸元……
text_block_list.orig_text: 相手の胸元……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Everyone, if you get tired, don't push yourself and tell Sensei, okay? Resting is part of practice too~
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
疲れたら
無理せずに
先生に言うのよ～？
休むのも練習のうちですからね～

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: Mm! Misato-chan?! ...Ah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
むっ！　
ミサトちゃん！？　
……
あっ！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: OI, YOUR CONTROL'S DAMN TERRIBLE! Hey... Teach, are you hurt?
text_block_list.orig_text:
オメー、
コントロール悪すぎだぜ！
よ
っと
……
先生、
怪我はねえっすか？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my... thank you! You are quite fast! Did you play any sports before?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
ありがとう～！
あなたはとっても足が速いのね～
何か
スポーツをやっていたの？

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: Ukeke! I'm not bragging, but I've always been confident in my speed. That's why I'm so good at running away after dining and dashing... Ah, never mind.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ウケケ！　
自慢じゃねえけど、
昔っから足の速さだけは自信あるんすよ。
だから食い逃げなんかを……
ああいやなんでもねえや。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my, I see~! So you were chasing after and catching people who did things like that? I think that's a wonderful attitude. That's great~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら
そうなの～！
そういったことをした人を追いかけて捕まえてるのね～
とっても素晴らしい心がけだと思うわ。
えらいえらい～！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, let's leave it at that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ああ、
そういうことにしといてくれ！

text_block_list.name: Asahi
text_block_list.text: Mm! That speed is definitely something to look forward to in the game. The other two are also well-built, so I'm sure they'll be able to hit home runs too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
その足の速さは試合でも十分に期待できるね。
他の二人もガタイはいいし、
きっと
ホームランも狙えそうだよ。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Really? How do you do that? You've got experience, right? Teach me the trick!
text_block_list.orig_text:
む……
本当か？　
どうやったら打てるんだ？
オマエ経験者だろ？　
ワシにコツを教えてくれ！

text_block_list.name: Asahi
text_block_list.text: U-Umm... Sorry. I don't know the trick to hitting a home run. I've never hit one before...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
えーっと……
ごめん。
ホームランのコツは分からないんだ。
俺、
今まで打ったことないから……

text_block_list.name: Asahi
text_block_list.text: I can teach you the basics, but I might not be able to give you advice on how to play in a way that will be effective at the national level.
text_block_list.orig_text:
基礎的なことは一通り教えられるけど、
全国大会で通用するようなプレーのアドバイスは、
俺にはできないかもしれない。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 3
text_block_list.text: Seriously...? Can we really reach the national summer tournament like that? Our coach's also an amateur!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジか……
そんなんで夏の全国大会行けるのか？
監督も素人なんだぞ。

text_block_list.name: Club Member 1
text_block_list.text: Then... who's going to teach us how to master beach baseball? I want to hit a super-sized home run!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ
誰がビーチベースボールを教えてくれるんだ？
ワシは超特大のホームランを打ちてえ！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: You mean you know a coach, right? Well then, may I ask you to invite them for our next practice~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
コーチ
ってことよね？
それじゃあ今度、
練習に呼んでもらってもいいかしら～？

text_block_list.name: Asahi
text_block_list.text: Wait a minute. Beach baseball isn't just about hitting home runs to win. You have to hone your throwing, catching, and hitting skills... mastering all of those is the key to success.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと待って。
ビーチベースボールは
ホームランが打てれば勝てるわけじゃないよ。
投げて、
捕って、
打って……
それら全てを鍛えないと駄目なんだ。

text_block_list.name: Asahi
text_block_list.text: There's no way you'd be able to find a coach that conveniently...
text_block_list.orig_text: そんな都合よくコーチが見つかるわけが……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: If {0}-kun says so, then trust in him!
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}くんが言うなら大丈夫だよー！

text_block_list.name: Club Member 2
text_block_list.text: Pipe down, Asahi! Hatsune-chan said he's a reliable man! Right, Misato-sensei?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゴチャゴチャうるせーぞ、
アサヒ！
ハツネちゃんもそう言ってんべ！　
ねー、
ミサト先生？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm sure there's no need to worry. He's extremely reliable~
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
きっと
心配ないわ。
とっても頼りになる子ですから～

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Practice began with the team members, whose attitudes had completely changed. To solve the many challenges facing the team, {0} decided to introduce them to a coach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
態度を一変させた部員たちと始まった練習。
多く積み重なる課題を解消するため、
{0}はコーチを紹介することになったのだった。
